def get_diff(args: argparse.Namespace, stdout: IO[str], stderr: IO[str]
    ) ->Optional[str]:
    # Get stub with existing annotations (current state - REPLICATE strategy)
    args.existing_annotation_strategy = ExistingAnnotationStrategy.REPLICATE
    stub_with_existing = get_stub(args, stdout, stderr)
    if stub_with_existing is None:
        return None
    
    # Get stub ignoring existing annotations (trace-based state - IGNORE strategy)
    args.existing_annotation_strategy = ExistingAnnotationStrategy.IGNORE
    stub_from_traces = get_stub(args, stdout, stderr)
    if stub_from_traces is None:
        return None
    
    existing_lines = stub_with_existing.render().splitlines(keepends=True)
    traces_lines = stub_from_traces.render().splitlines(keepends=True)
    
    diff_lines = list(difflib.ndiff(existing_lines, traces_lines))
    has_changes = any(line.startswith('+ ') or line.startswith('- ') for line in diff_lines)
    
    if not has_changes:
        return None
    
    return ''.join(diff_lines)
